newsitem.title: UK: MILUPA SAYS NO SALMONELLA FOUND IN MILK.
newsitem.headline: MILUPA SAYS NO SALMONELLA FOUND IN MILK.

text.p: Milupa, a unit of NV Verenigde Bedrijven Nutricia from the Netherlands, said its Milumil baby milk powder, which it is recalling, had not been identified as a source of Salmonella.
The recall is a precautionary measure, the firm said after 12 babies had been infected with a rare form of Salmonella.
"Milumil has not been identfied as a source of the Salmonella, but some of the babies affected had been fed with Milumil, so the company is withdrawing it as a precaution," Milupa said.
Milupa was investigating the incident in close co-operation with the health department and other experts, it said.
"However, the company would like to stress that its rigorous testing procedures at the factory have never shown the slightest signs of contamination," Milupa said in a statement.
